title: ComponentSet
description: A named group of components registered together via registerComponentSet. Shared fields (scripts, tags, spawnOffset) cascade down to member components unless overridden. The set itself can be referenced as a single entity in items and registry entries.

id.description: Unique identifier for this component set.

components.description: Member component definitions. Each entry is either a full component object (inline) or a reference object pointing to a registered component ID.

oneOf.title: ComponentRef
oneOf.description: Reference to a component already in the registry, with optional local overrides.

ref.description: ID of the target component in the registry.

transform.description: Override or supplement the referenced component's transform within this set.

spawnOffset.description: Override spawn offset for this member only.

properties.description: Property overrides merged on top of the referenced component's properties.

defaultTransform.description: Transform applied to the entire set as a group at spawn time.

spawnOffset.description: Spawn offset applied to the set root, cascaded to members unless they override it.

snappoints.description: Snap points for the set as a whole (e.g. attachment points for the assembled group).

scripts.description: Scripts shared across all member components. Merged with per-component scripts; per-component scripts run after set-level scripts at the same priority.

tags.description: Tags applied to the set and inherited by all members unless a member declares its own tags.

registerMode.description: Controls how registerComponentSet exposes the set. 'group' = set ID only; 'individual' = each member registered under its own ID; 'both' = both.

spawnOrder.description: Order in which member components are spawned. 'indexed' uses the component array index.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata for tooling or editor use.

enabled.description: When false, registerComponentSet skips this set entirely.
